description: This file contains a Python test class 'PamBasicTest' that extends 'OERuntimeTestCase' to run runtime tests related to PAM (Pluggable Authentication Modules). It verifies the presence of 'pam' in DISTRO_FEATURES and tests command behaviors ('login', 'passwd', 'su', 'useradd') on the target system.

classes.name: PamBasicTest
classes.description: A test class that checks basic PAM-related command functionality on a target system, with dependency decorators to ensure environment conditions.

methods.name: test_pam(self)
methods.description: Runs a series of commands ('login', 'passwd', 'su', 'useradd') on the target system and asserts their expected return statuses.
